_comment: Questions written by the team against the archive, to probe behaviour the 20 supplied development questions do not reach. `expect` is a substring the answer must contain; `expect_none` marks questions the archive genuinely cannot answer, where the correct behaviour is an honest refusal rather than a guess. Every expected value was verified against the fact store before the question was written.
